question: From how many and which existing source modes can a bosonic, family-singlet Spin(10)-vector (10,1) mediator be built at all (before any spectral search)?
verdict_scope: Representation theory and centre charges only. Building blocks: NS fermions psi (10,1), chi (1,6) and the E8 currents. Bulk Z4 charge, gap, residue, coupling and Schrieffer-Wolff residual are not decided.
summary_de: Zentrumsregel: alle bosonischen Komposita der Quelle haben q10 + q4 = 0 mod 4 (diagonales Zentrum trivial, wie in UR.SOURCE.OPERATOR_ORIGIN.01); (10, SU(4)-Singulett) hat 2 -> in jedem Kompositgrad verboten. (16,4)(16,4)(1,6) ist mit chi fermionisch, ein bosonisches (1,6) existiert nicht. Fuer SU(3)/SO(3)/A4-Familienneutralitaet gibt es Grad-2-Kandidaten: [J(16,4)J(16,4)] in (10, S^2 4) und [J(10,6)J(1,15)]; unter SU(3) ist das Singulett in S^2 4 die Komponente der weggelassenen Familienlinie. Z4, Luecke, Residuum, Kopplung und SW-Rest sind die naechsten Gates.
kills: A bosonic Spin(10)-vector SU(4)-family-singlet composite of source modes at any degree.
The composite (16,4)(16,4)(1,6) as a bosonic mediator.
Fermion bilinears (psi psi, psi chi, chi chi) as (10, family-singlet) mediators.
resolved: Minimal composite degree table per family-neutrality group.
Degree-2 candidates and their H-singlet counts: SU(3) 1+2, SO(3) 2+6, A4 2+8 ([J(16,4)^2] + [J(10,6)J(1,15)]).
next_gates: bulk Z4 charge of the candidate (requires the source->bulk map)
gap and residue: <M_A(t)M_B(0)> ~ delta_AB Z_Phi exp(-Delta t)
imported_premises: E8 branching D5 x A3 and NS fermions of U
